tuning.decision: GroupNorm (8 groups) with SGD lr=0.05 and K=20 local steps provides strictly monotonic post-round-15 convergence and avoids BatchNorm client drift collapse.

random.split_note: Stratified random 80/20 train/test holdout evaluated across 5 random seeds.

session-disjoint.split_note: A chronological split is not possible because frame.time has no date (99.2% NaNs under numeric parsing). Split is session-disjoint via GroupShuffleSplit(80/20) on (ip.src_host, ip.dst_host, stream/ports) across 5 random states x 5 seeds = 25 runs, ensuring zero session overlap.
